// SourceTests.cs
// Part 2 (Tuesday). Rename this file to SourceTests.cs when the lab says so.
// The test project will not build until IReadingSource, ScriptedSource,
// LogLineSource, ShiftMonitor, and MonitorSummary exist. Do not edit this file.

using Line3.Monitor;

namespace Line3.Monitor.Tests;

public class SourceTests
{
    // The same three readings, delivered two completely different ways.
    public static TheoryData<IReadingSource> BothSources() => new()
    {
        new ScriptedSource("bench script", "oven-temp", new double?[] { 201.5, null, 214.0 }),
        new LogLineSource("pasted log", new[] { "oven-temp,201.5", "oven-temp,--", "oven-temp,214.0" }),
    };

    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(BothSources))]
    public void P2_01_every_source_keeps_the_same_contract(IReadingSource source)
    {
        Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(source.Name));

        Reading? first = source.Next();
        Reading? second = source.Next();
        Reading? third = source.Next();

        Assert.NotNull(first);
        Assert.NotNull(second);
        Assert.NotNull(third);
        Assert.Equal(new double?[] { 201.5, null, 214.0 }, new[] { first.Value, second.Value, third.Value });
        Assert.Equal(new[] { 1, 2, 3 }, new[] { first.Sequence, second.Sequence, third.Sequence });
        Assert.All(new[] { first, second, third }, r => Assert.Equal("oven-temp", r.SensorId));
        Assert.True(second.IsMissing);
    }

    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(BothSources))]
    public void P2_02_an_exhausted_source_returns_null_and_keeps_returning_null(IReadingSource source)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        {
            Assert.NotNull(source.Next());
        }
        Assert.Null(source.Next());
        Assert.Null(source.Next());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void P2_03_a_line_that_cannot_be_split_is_an_unreadable_missing_reading()
    {
        var source = new LogLineSource("pasted log", new[] { "garbage" });
        Reading? reading = source.Next();
        Assert.NotNull(reading);
        Assert.Equal("unreadable", reading.SensorId);
        Assert.True(reading.IsMissing);
        Assert.Equal(1, reading.Sequence);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("oven-temp,NaN")]
    [InlineData("oven-temp,1e999")]
    [InlineData("oven-temp,")]
    public void P2_04_a_value_that_is_not_a_finite_number_is_missing(string line)
    {
        Reading? reading = new LogLineSource("pasted log", new[] { line }).Next();
        Assert.NotNull(reading);
        Assert.Equal("oven-temp", reading.SensorId);
        Assert.True(reading.IsMissing);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void P2_05_the_monitor_only_needs_the_interface()
    {
        IReadingSource source = new ScriptedSource("bench script", "oven-temp",
            new double?[] { 201.5, null, 244.0, null, 212.0 });
        MonitorSummary summary = ShiftMonitor.Summarize(source, maxReadings: 10);
        Assert.Equal(5, summary.Count);
        Assert.Equal(2, summary.Missing);
        Assert.Equal(244.0, summary.Highest);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void P2_06_the_monitor_stops_at_the_limit()
    {
        IReadingSource source = new ScriptedSource("bench script", "oven-temp",
            new double?[] { 201.5, 202.0, 203.0 });
        MonitorSummary summary = ShiftMonitor.Summarize(source, maxReadings: 2);
        Assert.Equal(2, summary.Count);
        Assert.Equal(202.0, summary.Highest);
        Assert.NotNull(source.Next());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void P2_07_all_missing_means_no_highest_value()
    {
        IReadingSource source = new ScriptedSource("bench script", "oven-temp", new double?[] { null, null });
        MonitorSummary summary = ShiftMonitor.Summarize(source, maxReadings: 10);
        Assert.Equal(2, summary.Missing);
        Assert.Null(summary.Highest);
    }
}
